criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map capabilities to needs without changing the stipulated need text.

reviews.decision_reason: Given the downstream handoff it received, map_coverage retained all eight allowed records, preserved record_id and need values as received, and correctly found no direct capability match for the mutated need values s01-s08.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize used the exact evidence_sources handoff ranks and ordered the eight unsupported coverage rows by upstream rank 1 through 8.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Produce the deterministic top-need recommendation and decision required by the execution contract.

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize retained eight ranked priorities and constructed the recommendation from the first ranked record. The incorrect top_need value is inherited from the upstream need mutation, not introduced here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Select every qualifying demand row and preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand selected the qualifying rows but did not preserve the corpus need field; it wrote need from source_id, turning the stipulated need text into s01-s08. This is the first root cause because the corrupted needs were then handed downstream exactly and drove all coverage to none and top_need to s01.
